_comment: Example candidate profile used by src/career/triage.py. Edit to your own criteria; the rules are applied in this order.
graduation_rule: The opening must accept at least one graduation window above. Internship and trainee programs usually state the accepted graduation dates; a title alone rarely does, so answer 'unknown' unless the title says it.

geography.rule: Preferred city first, then acceptable ones. Any other city is 'outside' and cannot be 'apply'.

level_rule: Only internship, trainee and junior/entry-level roles. Senior, mid-level (pleno, II, III), specialist, manager and lead roles are discarded.
prep_cost_rule: Estimate the preparation effort from the role: case-interview or exam-heavy processes are 'high', standard interviews 'medium', talent pools and open applications 'low'.
decision_rule: apply = entry level AND geography preferred or acceptable AND graduation not 'does_not_fit'. monitor = plausible but something is unknown or the cost is high. discard = wrong level, outside geography or graduation does not fit.
